info.name: SMKlog Quote API 1.4.0
info.description:
Live parcel rates from USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express for a single shipment sent from a US origin: inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia. Describe the item in plain words and the packed box size and weight are estimated server-side; supply exact dimensions and weight to skip the estimate. No account and no key. Rate limited per client (about 80 quote requests per hour); quotes cost real money to produce, so cache on your side and do not poll. Buying a label happens on smklog.com — this API prices, it does not sell.

Generated by SMKlog from the live OpenAPI document (https://quote-api.smklog.com/openapi.json) on 2026-10-12. No key needed: every request runs as-is.

item.name: Price one parcel from a US origin across USPS, UPS and FedEx (plus DHL Express to Germany and Australia)

request.description: Prices one shipment live against the carriers for the lane. Name the item in plain words and the packed box is estimated server-side (the estimate, its confidence and its assumptions come back in package); send length_cm, width_cm, height_cm, weight_kg and package_source "manual" to price an exact box instead. Up to five purchasable services come back, each a checkout total with the SMKlog fee inside and the carrier counter price beside it. One call per shipment: every call spends a live carrier rating.

item.name: Create a payment session for one parcel label (MPP intent "session")

request.description: Prices the shipment live, anchors the amount to one service, and returns a handoff URL opening the SMKlog checkout prefilled with the shipment. The human confirms the contents certification and the carrier-adjustment consent there and pays on Stripe hosted checkout. This operation never charges: the agent prepares, the human pays. Pass the quote_id from getParcelQuote and the session reuses that quote instead of spending a second carrier call.

response.name: 200 The session: intent, method, amount, currency, service, handoff_url, session_id,
response.body:
{
  "intent": "session",
  "session_id": "as_3f9c1b2e-7d64-4a8e-9c0f-5b2d1e8a7c33",
  "method": [
    "stripe",
    "card"
  ],
  "amount": 38.42,
  "currency": "USD",
  "service": "USPS Ground Advantage",
  "handoff_url": "https://smklog.com/assets/calculator?product=Yamaha+FG800+acoustic+guitar+in+a+hard+case&from_postal_code=07102&to_postal_code=30303&agent_session=as_3f9c1b2e-7d64-4a8e-9c0f-5b2d1e8a7c33",

  "quote_reused": true,
  "note": "Live quote at this moment, not a hold. The human confirms the shipping consents and pays on the checkout page. Keep session_id: get_checkout_status reports when the human has paid and when the label exists."
}

response.name: 400 invalid_json or invalid_request — the body is not the documented shape
422 session_failed — unpriceable, restricted, not a parcel, or more than one box
429 rate_limited

item.name: Read where a payment session stands

request.description: The stage of the checkout a payment session led to: awaiting_checkout, checkout_started, paid, label_ready (with the tracking number), delivered or refunded. Reads SMKlog order records only, no carrier call. Sessions live 30 days; an unknown or expired id answers 404 session_not_found. The answer never carries names, addresses or emails.
